summary: Bonta voted aye on AB 715, the antisemitism-coordinator and classroom-material oversight bill, after criticizing its rushed handling and pressuring co-authors to revise it. CAIR Action preferred her and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally, while the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel, endorsed her in the primary. Her aye vote on a bill she publicly questioned, alongside those split endorsements, underlies the assessment.
